title: Best of Sri Lanka | Culture, Coast and Capital
highlights: Explore Sri Lanka's ancient cities, where majestic ruins and historic sites reveal the island's rich history and architectural splendor.
Relax on Bentota Beach, renowned for its pristine golden sands and gentle waves, perfect for sunbathing and beachside relaxation.
Experience close-up encounters, feeding, and interacting with gentle elephants in a conservation-focused environment.
Enjoy the rhythmic beats and vibrant costumes, reflecting the rich heritage and artistry of Sri Lanka’s Kandyan tradition.
Admire the Lotus Tower, South Asia’s tallest structure, with its unique lotus design, and enjoy the panoramic views of Colombo.
overview:
About the Tour:
Endowed with a diverse collection of landscapes, climates, natural features and infamous beaches Sri Lanka has been enticing visitors for many years. Offering a myriad range of fun, adventure, and romance, it is among the best destinations in the world for those looking for an exotic vacation with a luxrious stay. Enjoy every minute of it. Be it the ocean, the forest or even the city, you’ll be able to soak it all in, what makes the soul-satisfying everything make it a paradise that bedazzles everyone!
Begin your amazing tour by visiting the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and watching the naughty elephants, yet adorable creatures bathe in the river near the orphanage where they engage in mischief, pull each other by their tails, and try to escape the hands of their caretakers in amusing ways. Awaken the adventurous soul in you by indulging in a myriad of water sports for fun and thrill in Bentota from jet skiing, banana boat ride, parasailing, paramotoring, speed boat ride, yachting, canoeing, kayaking, to boating in the mangrove forests. Conclude this tour by visiting the Red Mosque, a stunning candy-like red and white striped mosque named ‘Jami Ul-Alfar’ is the most spectacular building in your entire trip in Colombo.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Visit Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage | Transfer to Kandy | Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show
days.desc: Welcome to Colombo! Upon arrival, you'll be transferred to the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage to observe the daily routines of rescued elephants. Next, journey to Kandy. Upon arrival, check in and relax for a while. Afterward, board your transfer to enjoy a scenic drive around Kandy Lake, known for its natural landscape and historical significance. Then, experience the Kandyan dance performance, featuring traditional Sri Lankan music and dance. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage Visit on a Private basis
Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show on a Private basis

days.title: Arrival in Bentota | En Route Visit Tea Plantation and Tea Factory | Visit Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery
days.desc: After checking out of your hotel, you'll be transferred to the hotel in Bentota. En route, make a stop at the Tea Factory to learn about the tea-making process, and you can taste the authentic tea flavors. Next, visit the Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery, where you can witness baby turtles. See various species of turtles, like Green Turtles, Hawksbill Turtles, and Leatherback Turtles, and learn about conservation. Later, you'll be driven to your hotel. Check in for an overnight stay.

items.title: Stay at a Luxury hotel
items.hotel: Taj Bentota Resort & Spa, Sri Lanka

days.title: Day Tour to Madu Ganga and Bentota Beach
days.desc: Today, explore the Madu River and Bentota Beach. You can enjoy a serene boat ride on the Madu River, where you’ll encounter diverse bird species like kingfishers and herons. Visit the lush mangrove forests, 64 islands, cinnamon production garden, Kothduwa Temple, and other attractions. Next, head to Bentota Beach, renowned for its stunning views of the Indian Ocean. You can enjoy sunbathing, swimming, and thrilling water sports. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Madu Ganga Boat Safari | Balapitiya River Safari

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After checking out, you will be transferred to your Colombo. Check in and relax for a while. Begin your city tour with a visit to the iconic Lotus Tower for panoramic views of Colombo's skyline. Explore the Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple, renowned for its architecture. Visit the Pettah Floating Market for a unique shopping experience. Discover Colombo Fort, the World Trade Building, and other attractions. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Full Day Colombo Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out of the hotel and get transferred to Colombo Bandaranaike International Airport. This is where your trip comes to an end.
